exposure: Laparoscopic internal iliac artery temporary occlusion and uterine repair combined with hysteroscopic aspiration
cohort: 32 patients with type III cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Laparoscopic internal iliac artery temporary occlusion and uterine repair combined with hysteroscopic aspiration is an effective and safe treatment for type III cesarean scar pregnancy, with less postoperative complications and better protection of fertility function for patients.
gest_age: Not specified, but patients had cesarean scar pregnancies
